name: Goretusk Liver Pie
objectiveText: Salma Saldean needs 8 Goretusk livers to make a Goretusk Liver Pie . Goretusk Liver  ( 8 )

comments.body: ok ive done this quets so many times but im wondering.....how do the frickin things survive without a liver! can any1 tell me it took me like 20 mins just to get one so i just said 4get it plz help tyvm

Perhaps the most annoying Alliance quest ever concieved, you have to kill the goretusks in the area to get their livers despite them having a small chance of dropping.
Pretty easy though, just expect to spend some time on it.
the livers drop about 5x more often if you're not on the quest
drop percent is stupidly low

It took me like 30 mins to get 3 livers... then I got 4 in a row, the last a couple kills later. I dunno. I don't think the drop rate is all that good. But I farmed these in the middle of the farms, like how the road splits, I farmed in between the roads.
Or for those of you without cosmos, they roam just north of the graveyard. Which is on the little ridge north of sentinal hill

The drop rate is very bad in my opinion. What I did was hop on my main and kill like 30 of these, then mail the livers to my guy with the quest. An hour later I got it done with no tedious boar hunting.



...What's with Blizzard and making enemies that lack vital organs or certain body parts anyways?

[i][small]Edited, Feb 21st 2007 10:02pm by Markorat[/small][/i]

Salma Saldean is located within the Saldean Farm house in Westfall. Loc is 56,30.

I received 900 XP at level 13 for this quest.

notoriously one of the worst quests ever - very few of them actually have a liver - honestly - give this quest a miss!
replies: I'm not sure if the drop rate was tweaked for Forever but today (10/20/2026) I had much better success than in the past with the Goretusks (not the young type) outside of Moonbrook.

If you're looking at the comments on this recipe, plan, or quest you might be a collector or completionist. 
This is a compiled list of all of the cross-faction recipes in the game.

Most (not all) [skill=185] recipes on the Alliance side are sold by [npc=340]. The Horde do not have a corresponding NPC, so if you are an Alliance character wanting to create an alt on the opposite side to obtain the recipes for your main, unfortunately you'll have to have a level appropriate character to do the quests to obtain some of these recipes.

All of the recipes except one ([item=7994]) can be traded cross-faction on the neutral AH.
